title: One-step machine transition
statement: Let $A$ assign an instruction to each control state, let an oracle assign a Boolean answer to each of $d$ deciders and each bit string, and let $x$ be the input. One machine step leaves a halted configuration unchanged; otherwise, it executes the instruction at the current state: a deterministic register instruction updates the control state, registers, and result according to its register-machine transition, while a memory read branches according to the bit at the head, a memory write sets that bit to $1$, and a left or right move shifts the head position by $-1$ or $+1$, respectively.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ maps control states to memory-machine instructions
the oracle maps a decider index and bit string to a Boolean
the input configuration is a machine configuration with memory
